qe: The Avogadro constant, which defines the number of particles in one mole of a substance, is approximately:
qh: किसी पदार्थ के एक मोल में कणों की संख्या बताने वाला एवोगैड्रो स्थिरांक लगभग कितना है?
e: Mole rasayan me matra naapne ki SI ikai hai, bilkul waise hi jaise dravyaman ke liye kilogram ya lambai ke liye metre. Ek mole me 6.022 x 10^23 kan hote hain - chaahe woh atom hon, anu (molecule) hon ya aayan; isi sankhya ko Avogadro sthirank kehte hain, jo Italian vaigyanik Amedeo Avogadro ke naam par hai. Iski madad se rasayanik samikaran me atom-anu ki ginti tatha dravyaman ke beech pul ban jaata hai: udaharan ke liye ek mole carbon ka dravyaman 12 gram, ek mole paani ka 18 gram hota hai. 3.14 sthirank pi ka aakda hai (bhoomi-golakiy ganit me), 9.8 m/s^2 gurutv-kshetra ka tvaran hai, aur 1.6 x 10^-19 coulomb electron par aavesh hai - isliye yeh teeno aakde rasayan ke mole se juda nahi hain. Exam point: Avogadro sthirank = 6.022 x 10^23 kan prati mole; 1 mole gas STP par 22.4 litre gherta hai; mole = dravyaman / moliy dravyaman.

qe: How many moles of water are present in 36 grams of water (molar mass of water = 18 g per mole)?
qh: 36 ग्राम जल में कितने मोल जल होते हैं (जल का मोलर द्रव्यमान = 18 ग्राम प्रति मोल)?
e: Mole nikaalne ka sootra bahut saral hai: mole = diya gaya dravyaman, jise moliy dravyaman (molar mass) se bhaag dein. Yahaan diya gaya dravyaman 36 gram hai aur paani ka moliy dravyaman 18 gram prati mole hai, isliye 36 / 18 = 2 mole. Isi tarah agar 9 gram paani ho to 9/18 = 0.5 mole hota aur 180 gram ho to 10 mole hote. Dhyaan rahe ki moliy dravyaman har padarth ka alag hota hai - paani (H2O) ka 18, carbon dioxide (CO2) ka 44 tatha sodium chloride ka 58.5 gram prati mole hai. Isliye 0.5, 18 ya 36 mole wale vikalp ganit se mel nahi khaate; 18 to moliy dravyaman hi hai, ginti nahi. Rasayanik samikaran me is ganit ka upyog hota hai - jaise do mole paani se ek mole oxygen gas tatha do mole hydrogen gas milti hai. Exam point: mole = dravyaman / moliy dravyaman; 36 g paani = 2 mole; ek mole paani ke 6.022 x 10^23 anu.

qe: One mole of an ideal gas occupies what volume at standard temperature and pressure (STP)?
qh: मानक ताप तथा दाब (STP) पर एक मोल आदर्श गैस कितना आयतन घेरती है?
e: Standards tapaman tatha dabav (STP) par kisi bhi aadarsh gas ka ek mole 22.4 litre aayatan gherta hai - yah aakda gas ke prakar par nirbhar nahi karta, kyunki Avogadro ke niyam ke anusaar samaan tapaman tatha tapaman par barabar aayatan me barabar sankhya me anu hote hain. Isi karan rasayan me gas ke aayatan se seedha mole nikaal sakte hain: 11.2 litre gas mol ke 0.5 hisse ke barabar hoti hai aur 44.8 litre gas 2 mole. 11.2 litre aadha mole ka aayatan hai, isliye woh vikalp galat hai; 44.8 litre do mole ka hai. 24.4 litre aakda kuchh anya tapaman-dabav ki paristhiti me aata hai tatha hamesha ke liye sahi nahi hai; isliye woh vikalp bhi galat hai. Yaad rakhein ki mol ke teen aakde hain - 6.022 x 10^23 kan, gram me moliy dravyaman, aur STP par 22.4 litre aayatan (gas ke liye). Exam point: STP par 1 mole aadarsh gas = 22.4 litre; 0.5 mole = 11.2 L; 2 mole = 44.8 L; yahi Avogadro niyam ka vyavaharik roop hai.

qe: In the balanced chemical equation 2H2 + O2 gives 2H2O, how many moles of hydrogen are required to react completely with 1 mole of oxygen?
qh: संतुलित रासायनिक समीकरण 2H2 + O2 से 2H2O में, 1 मोल ऑक्सीजन के साथ पूर्णतः अभिक्रिया के लिए कितने मोल हाइड्रोजन चाहिए?
e: Santulit samikaran 2H2 + O2 = 2H2O yeh batata hai ki do mole hidrojan ek mole oxygen ke saath mil kar do mole paani banate hain. Isliye ek mole oxygen ke saath poori abhikriya ke liye do mole hidrojan chahiye. Samikaran ke aage likhe ank (coefficient) hi asli 'recipe' hote hain, isliye unhe santulit karna anivarya hai; agar samikaran santulit na ho to ganit galat aayega. Isi tarah yadi 4 mole hidrojan li jaye to usse 2 mole oxygen chahiye honge, aur 1 mole hidrojan ke liye 0.5 mole oxygen kaafi hoga. Isliye '1 mole' ya '4 mole' wale vikalp samikaran ke gunankon se mel nahi khaate - kyunki 1 mole hidrojan 0.5 mole oxygen se hi poora mel khaata hai, poori 1 mole se nahi. Yahi 'limiting reagent' ka prashn bhi banta hai, jisme jo padarth kam ho wahi abhikriya ki seema tay karta hai. Exam point: rasayanik samikaran ke coefficient = mole ka anupat; 2H2 + O2 = 2H2O me H2 aur O2 ka anupat 2:1 hota hai.

qe: Which of the following statements about the mole concept is NOT correct?
qh: मोल संकल्पना के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन सही नहीं है?
oe: One mole of any substance contains 6.022 x 10^23 particles
One mole of a substance has a mass in grams equal to its molecular mass
One mole of every substance always occupies 22.4 litres because all substances behave as gases
Mole is the SI unit used to measure the amount of substance
oh: किसी भी पदार्थ के एक मोल में 6.022 x 10^23 कण होते हैं
किसी पदार्थ के एक मोल का ग्राम में द्रव्यमान उसके अणु द्रव्यमान के बराबर होता है
प्रत्येक पदार्थ का एक मोल सदा 22.4 लीटर आयतन घेरता है क्योंकि सभी पदार्थ गैसों की तरह व्यवहार करते हैं
मोल पदार्थ की मात्रा मापने की SI इकाई है
e: 22.4 litre ka niyam keval gases ke liye hai, woh bhi STP (standard tapaman tatha dabav) par; woh sabhi padarthon par lagu nahi hota. Thos (solid) tatha drav (liquid) padarthon ka ek mole itna aayatan nahi gherta - jaise ek mole paani ka dravyaman 18 gram hota hai aur uski matra 18 millilitre ke karib hoti hai, 22.4 litre nahi. Doosra kathan bhi galat nahi hai: ek mole padarth ka gram me dravyaman uske anu-dravyaman ke barabar hota hai (isliye ise moliy dravyaman kehte hain). Pehle teesre tatha chauthi kathan sahih hain - ek mole me 6.022 x 10^23 kan hote hain aur mole padarth ki matra ki SI ikai hai. Isliye sahi uttar woh kathan hai jo har padarth ke liye 22.4 litre ka dawa karta hai; yahi dawa galat hai. Exam point: 22.4 litre sirf gas ke ek mole ke liye aur sirf STP par sahi hota hai; thos-drav ke liye moliy dravyaman hi maap hai.

qe: The number of atoms present in one mole of helium gas is:
qh: एक मोल हीलियम गैस में उपस्थित परमाणुओं की संख्या कितनी है?
e: Heeliyam ek nobal gas hai aur uske anu (molecule) ek hi paramanu se bante hain; isliye yahan 'molekan' tatha 'paramanu' ki ginti barabar ho jaati hai - ek mole heeliyam me 6.022 x 10^23 paramanu hote hain. Isi tarah neon, argon tatha anya nobal gas ke ek mole me bhi 6.022 x 10^23 paramanu hote hain, kyunki woh ek-atmik (monoatomic) hain. Lekin do-paramanik gas jaise hydrogen (H2), oxygen (O2) ya nitrogen (N2) ke ek mole me anu to 6.022 x 10^23 hote hain, par paramanu unse dugne - 1.204 x 10^24 - ho jaate hain; isliye vah vikalp heeliyam ke liye galat hai aur hydrogen wale prashn ka sahi uttar hota. 3.011 x 10^23 aadhe mole ka aakda hai, isliye woh bhi is prashn me nahi chalega; 12.044 x 10^23 sankhya anya ginti se aati hai. Isliye prashn ka pakka uttar 6.022 x 10^23 hai. Exam point: ek-atmik gas (He, Ne, Ar) ke ek mole me 6.022 x 10^23 paramanu; do-atmik gas (H2, O2) ke ek mole me 6.022 x 10^23 anu tatha 2 x 6.022 x 10^23 paramanu.
